motions.name: Motion Paper
motions.guidance: Free-form motions, motion-like applications or requests, oppositions, replies, supplemental briefs, points and authorities, and separately titled supporting declarations, regardless of filing party. Include a combined notice-and-motion whose substantive purpose is requesting relief. Preserve each separately titled paper as its own document; do not infer a family from proximity. Standardized qualifying court request forms remain Forms. Exclude standalone hearing notices, service proofs, court rulings/minute orders and neutral court-directed reports. Agency-authored advocacy can qualify; neutral agency reports remain Reports. Separately reproduced exhibits retain their own classification. A running title or internal heading alone is not a new document; a combined filing stays one paper unless a distinct opening is established.
